Hi team,

Attached is the Q3 stage-staleness scorecard — pulled this morning (filtered: open opps, aged stage > 60 days, last activity > 30 days). We surfaced ~42 deals across EMEA/US that are materially inflating our commit. Quick asks: 

1) Please review the tab with your name and do one of the following by EOD Thu (09/09):
   - Update stage and realistic close date (if still active)
   - Move to Contracting/Legal if awaiting signatures (include Doc link)
   - Archive / mark no-go with short reason
2) If you need CS/AE help to re-engage, loop them in and set a mutual next step in HubSpot.

Notes/criteria used are on the first sheet. I highlighted deals where forecast category = "commit" but confidence is low (discrepancy between activity and proposed close). We need this cleaned before the finance close on Friday.

Related: DEAL-4821 (StellarHealth) shows as "commit" but last contact was 45 days ago — Marcus please confirm whether we still have executive sponsor alignment or move to requalify.

Attachments: q3-stage-staleness-scorecard.xlsx (sheet-per-rep)
HubSpot link: https://hubspot.redwood/deals/DEAL-4821

Thanks — short, focused effort here rather than piecemeal follow-ups.
